Exact Claim Text: Metabolic health is more than a single number or isolated measurement.
Appears In: carousel: Slide 1 (Hook) & Slide 4; static_post: Main Headline; reel: Scene 1 & Scene 2
Evidence Basis: Metabolic syndrome and metabolic function are clinically defined by clusters of interconnected biomarkers (glucose, triglycerides, HDL, blood pressure) rather than any single reading alone.
Reviewer Notes: Verified by Lead Medical Content Editor against MedlinePlus and NIH/NIDDK guidelines. Tone is educational and non-stigmatizing.

Exact Claim Text: The human body functions as an interconnected system where organs constantly communicate to balance energy.
Appears In: carousel: Slide 2 (The Big Picture); reel: Scene 2
Evidence Basis: Cellular metabolism involves coordinated biochemical signaling between the pancreas, liver, skeletal muscle, brain, and adipose tissue to regulate fuel storage and utilization.
Reviewer Notes: Biochemically sound and appropriately framed for general audience comprehension without oversimplification.

Exact Claim Text: Blood glucose is the primary circulating fuel used by cells, with insulin acting as the key to help glucose enter cells.
Appears In: carousel: Slide 3 (Glucose and Energy); reel: Scene 3
Evidence Basis: NIDDK defines glucose as the main sugar found in blood that supplies energy to cells throughout the body, facilitated by insulin secreted by beta cells.
Reviewer Notes: Directly supported by NIDDK patient education consensus. Avoids fear-mongering around glucose spikes.

Exact Claim Text: Blood pressure, blood lipids (like triglycerides and HDL), and glucose regulation interact together to reflect cardiometabolic status.
Appears In: carousel: Slide 4 (Beyond One Measurement); reel: Scene 3; static_post: Supporting Copy
Evidence Basis: MedlinePlus and ADA clinical criteria highlight that cardiovascular and glycemic health are deeply linked, and isolated values must be interpreted in relationship to one another.
Reviewer Notes: Verified against MedlinePlus metabolic syndrome criteria. Appropriately includes cardiovascular indicators.

Exact Claim Text: Daily habits including regular movement, balanced nutrition, and restorative sleep support metabolic wellbeing over time without extreme regimens.
Evidence Basis: CDC and HHS guidelines show that consistent moderate daily activity and whole-food nutritional patterns improve insulin sensitivity and cardiometabolic resilience regardless of drastic weight loss.
Reviewer Notes: Follows public health consensus emphasizing consistency over extreme diets. Free of body shaming.

Exact Claim Text: Individual health metrics require personal clinical context; consult a licensed healthcare professional for personalized guidance.
Appears In: carousel: Slide 6 (Educational Disclaimer); static_post: Disclaimer Footer; reel: Scene 5 End-Card
Evidence Basis: ADA Standards of Care highlight the necessity of individualized clinical evaluation by qualified clinicians. Public education must explicitly disclaim medical diagnosis.
Reviewer Notes: Mandatory clinical disclaimer mandated by content compliance guidelines.

Exact Claim Text: Drinking lemon detox water guaranteed to melt visceral belly fat within 48 hours.
Evidence Basis: No peer-reviewed or authoritative evidence exists for spot-reduction or rapid fat melting through detox drinks.
Reviewer Notes: REJECTED: Contains prohibited terms ("guaranteed", "melt", "detox") and makes unsubstantiated miracle medical claims. Demonstrates Quality Gate blocking rules.
